definition: Producing content unsupported by the evidence, and across 10 sources a category the archive's better work refuses to treat as one thing. The most useful decomposition separates reasoning hallucination, where a flawed inference step propagates into a wrong conclusion and the model could in principle have got it right, from knowledge hallucination, where the model lacks the facts and no amount of further reasoning supplies them -- worse, repeated refinement can make an unsupported answer more convincing. That paper's ablation shows the two remedies are not interchangeable: reflection alone leaves coverage at exactly 100 percent while abstention alone leaves the hallucination proxy essentially unchanged at 20.0, because refusing on unanswerable prompts does nothing about errors on answerable ones. A second decomposition, in vision, splits by whether the failure survives masking the attended region -- masking works for the uncertainty type and is useless for the prior type by construction. Two measurement lessons recur. A hallucination number must be read with coverage: one system's 28.5-point reduction in its proxy costs 9.6 points of coverage, and its reflection-depth sweep is monotone in opposite directions on the two axes, which the authors use to justify keeping reflection shallow rather than to claim a best setting. And a mitigation that reduces mentions may be suppressing output rather than grounding it, which is why the stronger sources report word count, correct-object coverage and perplexity alongside the reduction.

evidence.note: A GRPO variant that teaches multimodal models to refuse when a referred object is absent, without losing localization accuracy on cases where it is present.
evidence.title: Teaching MLLMs to Say No: Generalized Referring Expression Comprehension via Refusal Calibrated GRPO

evidence.note: Refutes the standard account of vision-language hallucination -- that the model attends too little to the image -- by showing real and hallucinated objects draw equally strong attention, then uses a logit lens over the attended regions to separate two causally distinct hallucination types and treat each differently.
evidence.title: Same Attention, Different Truths: Put Logit-Lens over Visual Attention to Detect and Mitigate LVLM Object Hallucination

evidence.note: Separates hallucination into a reasoning failure and a knowledge failure, treats the first with a structured reflect-before-answering format and the second with a reward for abstaining when no sampled chain succeeds, and shows the two mechanisms are not interchangeable -- reflection alone never abstains, abstention alone never lowers the hallucination proxy.
evidence.title: REIN: Bridging the Gap between Reasoning and Reliability via Reflection and Abstention Alignment

evidence.note: Models hidden states as a superposition of truthful and hallucination-associated components and derives a closed-form Wiener filter over their covariances, giving mode-wise attenuation that is folded back into the model's own weights so inference runs unchanged and at the same speed.
evidence.title: Wiener Representation Filtering for VLM Hallucination Suppression

evidence.note: Detects the class of hallucination where a model confidently fabricates a parameter the user never gave, by running a LoRA adapter alongside the frozen model that restructures the residual stream and then names the offending parameter in words the agent can act on.
evidence.title: Actionable Hallucination Detection: Translating Latent Uncertainty into Agentic Critique

evidence.note: Reads a frozen vision-language model's forward pass as a structured computational trace -- a graph over image patches, query tokens and generated tokens with attention as edges, processed by interleaved relational, spatial and sequential modules -- and shows that structuring the same internals prior detectors already read lifts hallucination detection from a 69-75 AUC plateau to 90.
evidence.title: UniProbe: A Learnable Token-Level Hallucination Detector for Large VLMs using Multi-Structural Internal Representations

evidence.note: Adds a correctness-conditioned confidence term to the GRPO reward for medical visual question answering -- rewarding answer-token confidence when the answer is right and penalising it when wrong -- on top of an SFT cold start built from answer-conditioned reasoning traces filtered by a verifier.
evidence.title: CARE: Confidence-Aware Reasoning for Reliable Medical VQA

evidence.note: Uses 200 mathematical proof problems as a diagnostic, finding some reasoning models solve under 20% and cataloguing 10 fine-grained error types that numerical benchmarks hide.
evidence.title: Mathematical Proof as a Litmus Test: Revealing Failure Modes of Advanced Large Reasoning Models

evidence.note: Keeps the LLM as the reasoner while a symbolic solver supplies a Logic-Augmented Context, so conflicts flagged by execution direct attention to violated constraints instead of replacing deduction.
evidence.title: MAC-Reasoner: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Enhancing Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models

evidence.note: A 4B small reasoning model that classifies document-claim pairs as grounded or hallucinated for RAG pipelines and produces evidence-grounded justifications.
evidence.title: HalluGuard: Evidence-Grounded Small Reasoning Models to Mitigate Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

name: hallucination
